title: The Duke's Chambers
text:
*Thomas leads you through servant passages to the Duke's chambers. The halls are grand but neglected — tapestries gathering dust, candles burned low and unreplaced.*

*Duke Aldren lies in a vast bed, propped against silk pillows. He was once a powerful man — you can see it in his broad frame — but now he is wasted. His skin is sallow, his eyes clouded. A half-empty goblet of wine sits on the bedside table.*

Duke Aldren: "Who... Thomas, who is this?"

Thomas: "A friend, my lord. Someone who can help."

*The Duke's eyes focus briefly — a flash of the sharp mind still buried under the poison's fog.*

Duke Aldren: "Goran... he has changed everything. My guards, my advisors... I feel so weak. I cannot even rise from this bed. Something is wrong — I know it — but I cannot..."

*His eyes close. The effort of speaking has exhausted him. But you've seen enough. This man is being murdered by inches.*

choices.text: Take the wine goblet for analysis — this is evidence
Swear to the Duke that you will save him and this city
